findings.title: A code field that deletes Arabic digits
findings.message: Typing ١٢ into this code field kept neither ١٢ nor 12, so Arabic digits are deleted.
findings.fix: Accept Arabic-Indic digits and convert them to 0 to 9 before checking or sending the value, instead of stripping them.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" class="otp-input" autofocus="" autocomplete="one-time-code">

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.message: "جلسة بنكية آمنة ومشفّرة بمعايير البنك ال…" is 11px.
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.
